title: Swift Indian Ban on JPMorgan Unit Seen as Warning to Traders
summary: India’s securities regulator issued an interim order against a JPMorgan Chase & Co. unit in record time, a move market watchers say could deter attempts to manipulate the country’s new closing stock auction.

title: CME CEO Spars With CFTC Chair About Prediction Market Oversight
summary: The head of CME Group Inc. told the chairman of the Commodity Futures Trading Commission that the agency needed to do more to prevent manipulation on prediction markets as the trading startups grow into multibillion-dollar businesses.

title: Latest Oil Market News and Analysis for Aug. 21
summary: Oil headed for a substantial weekly gain, as a US push to isolate Iran’s economy raised the specter of further market disruption.

title: Asian Bonds Follow Treasuries Lower, Dollar Slips: Markets Wrap
summary: Asian bonds declined and the dollar remained under pressure after a rally in Treasuries faded, with investors betting that US efforts to contain long-term borrowing costs through buybacks may offer only a temporary reprieve.

title: Japan Lintec’s Stock Slides as Major Shareholder Sets Exit Plan
summary: Lintec Corp. shares fell to a three-month low on Friday after its largest shareholder announced plans to dispose its stake, as a growing number of Japanese companies divest non-core assets to improve their capital efficiency.

title: Pop Mart Drops After Warning 2026 Growth Target Out of Reach
summary: Pop Mart International Group Ltd. shares fell the most in nearly five months after the Labubu toymaker said it will likely miss its 2026 sales-growth target, citing a far tougher-than-expected first half.

title: India’s Mazumdar-Shaw Is On A Mission to Save Lives
summary:
Known as India’s ‘Queen of Biotech’, Kiran Mazumdar-Shaw built Biocon from a rented garage almost 50 years ago. Today, her multibillion-dollar company is one of the world’s biggest producers of insulin, and a leading force in biosimilars. 
As she looks at handing over her life’s work to successors, Mazumdar-Shaw talks to Bloomberg’s Haslinda Amin about her pioneering journey as a female entrepreneur in India, her mission to deliver life-saving therapies to patients and what she believes India must do to tackle an AI future.  (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Inghams Shares Drop as Higher Feed and Fuel Costs Hit Outlook
summary: Inghams Group Ltd. shares dropped the most in about two months after the Australian poultry producer flagged that higher feed, diesel and packaging costs caused by the war in the Middle East would impact its earnings forecast in the next year.

title: Evergrande Creditors Owed $45 Billion Now Face More Complex Path
summary: China Evergrande Group’s creditors have known for years they’ll only get pennies on the dollar back in one of the country’s biggest ever liquidations. Now, getting even just that has become more complex.

title: Ten Cap's Jun Bei Liu on What Bessent Is Up Against
summary: Ten Cap co-founder and Lead Portfolio Manager Jun Bei Liu breaks down the difficulty of intervening in the bond market at a time when AI firms are pouring massive capital into capital expenditure. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Gold Set for Third Weekly Gain on US Treasury Buyback Plans
summary: Gold was on track for a third weekly gain after the US Treasury’s unexpected ramp-up in buybacks of long-dated government debt underscored concerns about its burden.

title: British Food Firms Urge Burnham to Act on Costs as Drought Hits
summary: Food and drink makers called for relief from new UK Prime Minister Andy Burnham as European droughts push up the price of key ingredients.

title: Hua Hong, Kingboard, Zijin Gold May Join Hong Kong’s Stock Index
summary: Hang Seng Indexes Co. may add chipmaker Hua Hong Grace Semiconductor Ltd., AI-related firm Kingboard Laminates Holdings Ltd. and miner Zijin Gold International Co. to Hong Kong’s equity benchmark, according to analysts.

title: Exxon Warns Kazakhstan’s Top Oil Field to Peak Within Years
summary: ExxonMobil Holdings Corp. has told Kazakhstan that the country’s top oil field is already on the cusp of peak output and its production will slump sharply in the coming decade.

title: Broadcom Seeking $60B in AI Debt Deal
summary: Broadcom Inc. is in talks with a group of lenders to raise more than $60 billion in debt for an AI chip financing deal that will benefit Anthropic PBC and other companies, according to people with knowledge of the matter. The financing, which is still being ironed out, may also include a roughly $30 billion junior debt tranche, said some of the people, who asked not to be identified because the information is private. Bloomberg News Deals Reporter Ryan Gould breaks down the significance of a potential deal, and who the players may be. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Holcim Is Acquiring Part of James Hardie’s European Business
summary: Holcim Ltd. is acquiring part of the European business of James Hardie Industries Plc for €840 million ($981 million), expanding its building, sustainable flooring and walling solution offerings.

title: Anthropic Set to Add Citigroup to Top IPO Banks on Mega-Listing
summary: Anthropic PBC is set to add Citigroup Inc. to the banks working on its initial public offering, according to people familiar with the matter, as Wall Street jostles for roles on the artificial intelligence firm’s debut.

title: J&J Snack Foods CEO on Snack Nostalgia, Turnaround Plans
summary: Dan Fachner, CEO of J&J Snack Foods, discussed the company's strategic focus on the food service segment, which accounts for 60% of its business. He emphasized the strong recovery and growth potential in experiential venues such as theaters, theme parks, and ballparks, where iconic brands like ICEE, Dippin' Dots, and Super Pretzel are popular. He speaks with Romaine Bostick on "The Close." (Source: Bloomberg)
